entities.summary: Maksym Oleksandrovych Kryvtsov was a Ukrainian poet, photographer, public figure, volunteer and soldier. He was a Junior sergeant of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and participant in the Russian-Ukrainian war. Hero of Ukraine.
